topic: Call of Duty veteran can no longer recommend game dev career
caption_text: Veteran Call of Duty, Gavin Goslin, bilang dia nggak lagi rekomendasiin karier di game development. Menurut survei GDC, 34% responden kena PHK dalam 2 tahun terakhir. Menurut kamu, industri game masih layak dijadiin karier nggak?
